name: hud_cheat_clear_nanite_panel_cheat_sentinel
description: HudCheat::ClearNanitePanelCheatSentinel clears the local player nanite-panel value only when it carries the recovered cheat sentinel.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred until the surrounding HudCheat command/state cluster is verified.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x406cf0 reads g_GameStateOrMapTable, returns immediately when it is null, reads playerState at offset 0x04, compares nanitePanelLevel at offset 0xf38 with 0x075bcd15, and writes zero only on that match.
The native smoke validates null game state, sentinel clearing, and non-sentinel preservation.
